title: Predictive Modeling Project Context
summary: Governed model-development charter for Classification Predictive Model TEST.

payload.businessPurpose: The business objective is to Create a binary classifier predictive model to estimate the probability of a transaction being fraudlent. The model should support this objective through measurable performance improvement, documented decision logic, and ongoing monitoring against approved success metrics.
payload.intendedUse: The model will be used to real time scoring. Use of the model should be limited to the approved population, governed decision process, documented controls, and monitoring framework.
payload.target: The target variable is defined as The binary target variable is Class which is used to label fraud and non-fraud transactions. The final target definition should specify the positive outcome, measurement window, exclusion rules, and treatment of records without a valid observed outcome.
payload.population: The modeling population includes Customers with more than 8 months-on-book. Eligibility criteria, exclusions, observation-window requirements, and population counts should be documented for development, validation, and monitoring.
